answer: Onboarding happens inside a protected haven: a new key locks a refundable bond that cannot drop below a published nadir for four epochs, and it cannot vote or draw emission until that window ends. Entry also requires four established attesters, each spending a one-per-epoch voucher and each sampled from a randomized meadow so that no two share a first-seen epoch or a funding parent. If two admitted keys later collide on a parent UTXO, both bonds are slashed to the nadir and the spent vouchers are burned.
